description:
Marble is a private workout journal for fast logging, focused training, and clear progress. No account, ads, or third-party tracking.

WRITE IT YOUR WAY
Type or paste a workout in gym notation, bring in multi-day notes, or import a Hevy or Strong CSV. Scan handwritten workouts with on-device text recognition, dictate on compatible devices, or send supported workout content to Marble from the share sheet. When available, Apple Intelligence helps structure workout text on your device.

Review exercises, sets, weights, reps, distances, dates, rest, and notes before saving. Lines Marble can't organize stay in review until you fix them or keep them in your workout notes. Weights without a unit follow your kg or lb preference. Save an unfinished review and return to it later. Log the same typed workout on another day while keeping same-day duplicate protection.

KEEP YOUR TRAINING MOVING
- Log weights, reps, distance, time, RPE, rest, and notes
- Repeat your last set or use Save + Next
- Start and finish workout sessions
- Search Workout History by workout or exercise and review a session before repeating it
- Build weekly splits and reusable sprint prescriptions
- Follow rest timers with a Live Activity and rest-complete alerts

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Track personal records, estimated one-rep max, weekly goals, and consistency
- See your Top Exercises and the dates of your best lifts
- Review Monthly Reports and Daily Highlights
- Explore muscle-group, rep-range, effort, supplement, and calendar views
- Distinguish dense Progress Details with colored charts, exact values and accessible legends
- Record bodyweight or import it from Apple Health
- Compare a lift's estimated strength relative to bodyweight
- Browse attributed training quotes that fit your text size

CONNECT WITH iOS
Add a Weekly Goal widget, find exercises in Spotlight, and use Siri or Shortcuts to log sets and manage workout sessions. Find and open past sessions, prepare a workout summary to share, and keep your current workout and rest timer together in a Live Activity. Open quick logging from supported Control Center, Lock Screen, or Action button controls. With a paired Apple Watch, control your iPhone workout: start, repeat the last confirmed set, manage rest and finish.

OPTIONAL APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Import Apple Health workouts, including workouts recorded by Apple Watch and Garmin apps that write to Health. Optionally export completed strength sessions or track a live strength workout with pause and resume. Heart rate requires an available compatible sensor; the Watch companion controls the phone and does not collect wrist sensors. Health access is permission-based; you can use Marble without it.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR DATA
Your core training data is stored locally on your iPhone or iPad. Export and restore a portable JSON backup. Progress photos and videos stay on your device and are not included in those backup files. Marble has no account system or Marble-operated server.

Apple Intelligence features require a compatible device, supported language, and Apple Intelligence availability. Workout notation and structured file imports can be reviewed without Apple Intelligence.
promotionalText: Log with Siri and Shortcuts, review dictated or shared workouts, and explore clearer Progress Details. Your training stays private and under your control.
whatsNew:
More ways to log your workout, with clearer progress and the same review-before-save control.

- Use Siri and Shortcuts for strength, distance and timed sets, including sprint times to a tenth of a second.
- Keep your running workout and rest timer together in a Live Activity.
- Find and open workouts, review a session before repeating it, or prepare a summary to share.
- Dictate on compatible devices, then edit and review the transcript.
- Send supported workout text, files or images to Marble from the share sheet.
- Control your iPhone workout from Apple Watch: start, repeat a confirmed set, manage rest and finish.
- Optionally track live strength workouts in Apple Health, with pause and resume.
- Read explicit rep and weight lists more faithfully, preserving the units you wrote.
- Explore colorful Progress Details with readable metric cues, category values and accessible legends.

Existing workout notes, count-only drills, sprint efforts and exercise order remain part of your editable review.
